errors.evidence: The Y-axis is not labeled. 'Приходи от електронна търговия (млрд. долара)' is the label in the legend for the blue area, not the label for the Y-axis.
The chart is an area chart, not a line chart. Describing the blue filled area as a 'solid blue line' is structurally inaccurate.
The growth indicators are presented as orange/brown percentage values (data points), not as 'red lines'.

The description omits most of the explicit data points provided on the chart. It only mentions the start and end values for revenue, missing the intermediate values for 2018-2022 (134, 156, 191, 211, 245). It also only mentions two of the seven growth percentages, omitting those for 2017 (0%), 2019 (16%), 2020 (22%), 2021 (10%), and 2022 (16%).
